note: Pass and fail of the steps of the phone chapters of the guide (mobile-chapters.json). A step is verified when a walk of the application on a device (apps/mobile/qa/device/results) has a passed visit of its screen. The criterion of a step is its expect; the steps that have none have a pattern here (confirmedBy: the pattern was written from the heading that walk recorded and is checked against it; without confirmedBy it comes from the title of the catalogue and is a plan, not a measurement). Score a new walk with: node scripts/hdsd/verification.mjs --walk <walk.json> --list.
